p: Stanhope Road runs through the residential side of South Shields, so this Admiral is a local stop rather than a seaside attraction. It's an adult gaming centre and 18+ only.

If you're in town for longer, head for Arbeia Roman Fort on the Lawe Top, where you can see a reconstructed gatehouse and barrack block from the fort that guarded the mouth of the Tyne. South Shields Museum in the town centre covers local history and the writer Catherine Cookson, who grew up here. Ocean Road, leading down to the sea, is famous locally for its curry houses, and Sandhaven Beach at the end of it is a big sweep of sand with the pier stretching out alongside.
